title: Guitar session: Kahn, Ron Tototz, and friends
description: Four men gathered around a seated guitarist outside a wooden-framed building with woven matting walls and rolled reed blinds. Larry identifies Kahn at right — the company clerk, "morning report written by him," who "walked funny, stiff legged like he had polio" — with Ron Tototz to Kahn's left. Of the hooch: "I slept in the hooch, once you enter the door, immediately on the right."
researchNotes: Identifications are Larry's own (Memories comment, 2026-08-13; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0003-c18006986.json). Both name spellings are phonetic. Part of the guitar-session series with VN-0007 and VN-0008. 2026-09-12 (giscus-vn-0003-c18415619.json), with 'Location: Ton Son Nhut': he named the same two men in the same positions a month after the first comment, and repeated in his own words what he said on 2026-08-23 about Kahn writing the morning reports (giscus-stories-c18118728.json; issue #27). Which hooch he means by 'the hooch' where he slept — this building, or T 123 of VN-0017/VN-0019 — the comment does not say.
